description: Geodades is the download service for official cartography of the Government of Andorra, part of the Andorran spatial data infrastructure. The service read on 2026-09-28 lets users filter series by name, publication date and format, choose products on a map (some series have a scale restriction), add them to a download basket and complete the download through a form with user details; offered formats include GeoTIFF and cloud-optimised GeoTIFF, JPG, ECW, LAZ point clouds, ASCII grids, shapefiles, CAD formats (DWG, DXF, DGN), KML, GPX, MDB and PDF. Coverage is the Principality of Andorra. Access is free after filling in the form; the licence of the data is not stated in the form read. Caveats: the series list loads by script and was not enumerated, so which elevation, orthophoto and topographic products are current was not checked. It supports terrain, imagery and base mapping for landslide, avalanche and flood exposure studies of Andorra's mountain roads and settlements. Related record: data-iea-andorra-land-cover-map-2012 complements it with land cover.
